newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T early gains lost to profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T early gains lost to profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries Plc lost their early gains by midsession on Thursday as some investors opted to cash in gains after Wednesday's 28p rise, dealers said.

After rising 18p to 559p in early trade, near its high for the year, the stock was down 2p at 539 by 1151 GMT. Trade was active at 10.9 million shares -- making it the second most active stock in the London market.
Dealers pointed out that the size of any settlement of U.S. tobacco litigation remained to be seen and could anyway still be some way off.
"It has had a good rise, now people are waiting for the next news," said the head of equity trading at one brokerage.

B.A.T earlier today declined comment on news that the tobacco industry in the U.S. -- including its Brown & williamson unit -- was in talks on a possible settlement of the massive litigation over smoking-related illnesses.
The tobacco-to-insurance group stuck to its previous line that it would evaluate any sensible proposal made in good faith.
